title: Cyber Worlds · Mohammed El-Aouni
description: Explore Mohammed El-Aouni's present-day cybersecurity portfolio hub, then enter offline fictional Red Team, Blue Team, GRC and Security Research practice worlds representing possible future career paths.

defaultCaptions.x: Step into Mohammed El-Aouni's Cyber Worlds: his current portfolio hub, with four safe fictional practice worlds for possible future careers.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Cyber Worlds is a playable 3D cybersecurity portfolio for Mohammed El-Aouni, an ENSA Oujda student. Explore current work in the hub, then visit offline fictional Red Team, Blue Team, GRC and Security Research future-path simulations.
defaultCaptions.reddit: A Three.js third-person portfolio world: a normal human explorer, a present-day cybersecurity hub and four independent offline career-practice worlds with simple fictional challenges and world abilities.
defaultCaptions.discord: Explore Mohammed El-Aouni's current cybersecurity work in the hub, then discover four possible cyber-career worlds in this bilingual 3D portfolio.
